These city-centre extracts are a derived database distributed under ODbL 1.0.
They contain roads and, where available in the extract, parks, waterways and building footprints.
The source snapshot dates and feature counts are recorded per city in manifest.json.
Generated with scripts/build-city-streets.mjs using the public Overpass API.
Pune building coverage was expanded with scripts/extend-pune-buildings.mjs to cover
the demo offices and surrounding neighbourhoods. The building bounds and separate
snapshot date are recorded in manifest.json. Heights use OSM height/level tags
where available, with estimates elsewhere; display depth is enhanced at wide zoom.

Client names and client/branch coordinates are separate CRM records. Street data does
not establish or verify the address of any client or branch.
